scenario: I am an expert motorcyclist participating in a Bike Week. As I am driving down the road in front of a large group of ten bikers, I suddenly notice that a biker up front is losing control over his machine and is falling. I can easily evade him myself but the bikers behind me will crash into each other and die in the resulting pile-up. If I let my bike run into the falling biker while jumping into the roadside ditch myself, I will warn the others in time. This will kill this biker, but I will save the other ten.
choice: I decide to alert the others about the imminent accident by running your bike into the falling bikers’ machine
outcomes: I am thrown into the roadside ditch.
The ten bikers behind are alerted to the danger.
The ten bikers behind avoid a pile-up.
The ten bikers behind remain alive.
